name: Kaya, Geist Hunter
oracle_text:
+1: Creatures you control gain deathtouch until end of turn. Put a +1/+1 counter on up to one target creature token you control.
−2: Until end of turn, if one or more tokens would be created under your control, twice that many of those tokens are created instead.
−6: Exile all cards from all graveyards, then create a 1/1 white Spirit creature token with flying for each card exiled this way.
blocked_sentences: −2: Until end of turn, if one or more tokens would be created under your control, twice that many of those tokens are created instead.

needs.what: a one-shot effect that sets up a player-wide token-creation replacement (token_multiplier 2, affects_player you) lasting until end of turn, independent of its source: it must keep applying after the planeswalker that created it leaves the battlefield (611.2a / 614 effect from a resolved ability)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: replace_token_creation exists only as a static ability, read off a permanent on the battlefield for as long as it stays there; no op in reference creates a timed replacement. grant_ability as an op may grant only triggered or activated abilities (the static form is 'as long as', not 'until end of turn'), and granting a static to Kaya would end the doubling if she left the battlefield, which the printed effect does not
